features.name: Account login and past orders
features.description:
As a returning customer
  I want to log into my account
  So that I can see my past orders
  Background:
    Given the demo web app is running

scenarios.name: Successful login shows the Past Orders page

steps.text: Given I am on the login page
When I log in with username "alice@example.com" and password "password123"
Then I should be redirected to my account dashboard
And I should see a list of my past orders
Given I am on the login page
When I log in with username "alice@example.com" and password "wrong-password"
Then I should see a login error message
And I should remain on the login page
Given I am logged in as "alice@example.com"
When I log out
Then I should be redirected to the home page
And I should not see account information

scenarios.name: View details of a past order

steps.text: Given I am logged in as "alice@example.com"
And I am on the Past Orders page
When I view the details of my most recent order
Then I should see the order date, total, and line items

features.name: Shopping cart operations
features.description:
As a shopper
  I want to manage items in my cart
  So that I can purchase exactly what I need
  Background:
    Given the demo web app is running
    Given I am on the demo shop home page

scenarios.name: Add the same item twice increases quantity to 2

steps.text: When I add the first product to the cart
And I add the first product to the cart
And I go to the cart page
Then I should see quantity 2 for the first cart item
And the subtotal for the first cart item should be the unit price times 2
And the cart total should equal the subtotal of all items

scenarios.name: Increase quantity from the cart page

steps.text: When I add the first product to the cart
And I go to the cart page
And I increase the quantity of the first cart item to 2
Then I should see quantity 2 for the first cart item
And the subtotal for the first cart item should be the unit price times 2
And the cart total should reflect the updated subtotal

scenarios.name: Remove an item from the cart

steps.text: When I add the first product to the cart
And I go to the cart page
And I remove the first cart item
Then the cart should be empty

scenarios.name: Add two different items and remove one

steps.text: When I add the first product to the cart
And I add the second product to the cart
And I go to the cart page
Then I should see 2 items in the cart
When I remove the second cart item
Then I should see 1 item in the cart
And the cart total should equal the remaining item subtotal

features.name: Checkout Process
features.description:
As a shopper
  I want to complete my purchase
  So that I can receive my magical items
  Background:
     Given the demo web app is running
     Given I am on the login page
     When I log in with username "alice@example.com" and password "password123"
     Given I am on the demo shop home page
     When I add the first product to the cart
     And I go to the cart page

steps.text: When I complete the transaction
Then I should be redirected to the order history page
And I should see the new order in the history

features.name: View Inventory
features.description:
As a shopper
    I want to view the inventory on the demo web app
    So that I can see the available products
    Background:
        Given the demo web app is running

scenarios.name: View inventory list on home page

steps.text: Given I am on the demo shop home page
Then I should see a list of products with their names and prices

scenarios.name: Inventory shows images and prices for each product

steps.text: Given I am on the demo shop home page
Then each product should display an image and a price
Given I am on the demo shop home page
Then I should see at least 3 products listed

scenarios.name: Navigate to item details from the list

steps.text: Given I am on the demo shop home page
When I click on the first product's details link
Then I should see the product details page with name, price, and description

features.name: Item details
features.description:
As a shopper
    I want to view item details on the demo web app
    So that I can see more information about a product
    Background:
        Given the demo web app is running

scenarios.name: View item details from home page

steps.text: Given I am on the demo shop home page
When I click on the first product's details link
Then I should see the product details page with name, price, and description
Given the demo web app is running
Then the page title should contain "Ye Olde Magic Shop"

features.name: Demo web-app cart
features.description:
As a shopper
  I want to add items to the cart on the demo web app
  So that the cart reflects the added items and totals
  Background:
    Given the demo web app is running

scenarios.name: Add first product to cart and verify it appears in cart

steps.text: Given I am on the demo shop home page
When I add the first product to the cart
And I go to the cart page
Then I should see the product in the cart with quantity 1
And the total price should equal the product price
